request: Multicolor Handheld, Retro TV and Cyberpunk frames; previews must show the corresponding actual designs.
parent_objective: Piantor wireless slim / Filo36; custom_display_frames and interactive_assembly
scope: Multicolor finishes on existing revH faces; actual design previews; same colors in viewer, GLB and FreeCAD import; English guide and existing public main/Pages destination. No new geometry, parts or fabrication qualification.
acceptance: Three distinguishable front-facing actual-mesh thumbnails with corresponding theme colors
One click applies complete theme palette; custom body color and per-half JSON preserved
Identical mesh positions/normals and oriented triangle membership with at most four material groups
Raised feature roles match actual left/right D-pad, buttons, grille, bezel, vents, traces, panel and node
GLB and FreeCAD active-link colors match the theme, with JSON/save-reopen
Offline, sidebar, mobile touch and performance remain functional; public readback

review.agreement: Use shared implicit style palettes on existing relief, retain configuration schema and verify actual colored faces; no material objection.

findings.finding: Uniform preview/runtime material conflicts with already contrasted documentary render.
findings.disposition: Shared palette and actual relief material groups across viewer and FreeCAD.

findings.finding: Distinct PNG hashes do not prove legibility or matching theme.
findings.disposition: Larger upright front previews; inspect rendered cards and verify role locations/materials.

findings.finding: Theme preset changes prior preserve-body-color behavior.
findings.disposition: Intentional complete-theme choice; explicit guide and tests. Body override remains separate and JSON preserves it.

findings.finding: Material arrays, mirror and editable FreeCAD heights can diverge.
findings.disposition: At most four contiguous groups; exact geometry, GLB, active-link face-color and height-aware checks.

findings.finding: A persistent green selection overlay obscures the new frame palette.
findings.disposition: Retain the frame selection/link but color its surface only during hover; selected theme colors remain visible. Exact export and hover tests passed.

retrospective.trigger: User expected multicolor themed frames and distinct previews.
retrospective.cause: Each correct STL was rendered with one green material in small oblique thumbnails; testing PNG uniqueness did not establish visible relief or theme color. The existing documentation render had contrasting accents that the interactive view did not reproduce.
retrospective.correction: One shared four-color palette per theme; face/triangle roles on existing raised features, readable upright previews, actual palette selection, matching GLB and native face colors.
retrospective.prevention: Verify physical feature locations on both meshes, all four exported materials, JSON/native save-reopen and actual desktop/mobile cards.
